_doc: Copy to <your repo>/.claude/perf/<game>/profile.json and fill in. Everything game-specific the scripts need is here; the skill itself knows no game. Remove this _doc.
name: My Game

page.title: My Game Android profile
page.fpsIntro: One group of bars per level, one bar per quality level, on the phone. Pick the section; tick the stress scale to see the same levels at the stress render scale. A red ring marks a cell with frames over 33 ms.
page.scaleReleaseNote: Release render scale at Low, Medium and High.
page.scaleStressNote: Stress render scale at Low, Medium and High.
page.shotsIntro: High quality level on the phone, in play.
page.costIntro: Measured at High. Negative readings count as 0.
page.costNote: What is on at every level, how the quality levels differ, what a section is. Slow frames are frames over 33 ms: a missed 60 Hz frame or worse.
